name: wadle
description: Web-based AI for vibe programming — builds, modifies and converts real software until it actually works.

scripts.//deps: Every entry point that needs node_modules checks for it first, so a fresh clone says what is wrong instead of 'tsc: not found'.
scripts.//start: The UI must be built before the server can serve it — dist/ is gitignored, so a fresh clone has none.
scripts.start: node scripts/ensure-deps.mjs && node scripts/preflight.mjs && pnpm --filter @wadle/web build && pnpm --filter @wadle/server start
